parsed.post: New personal best! Reduced TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps, dropping val_bpb from 0.8375 to 0.8351. Batch halving seems to be working well at depth 8. Next, I'll try increasing MATRIX_LR slightly to 0.06 to see if we can accelerate convergence with more steps.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.06 to see if the increased number of optimizer steps from the smaller batch size allows for a higher learning rate to drive better convergence.
